name: How do I compare two luxury home builder bids that look very different?

mainEntity.name: Why do luxury custom home builder estimates vary so much, and how do I compare them fairly?
mainEntity.text: Why do luxury custom home builder estimates vary so much, and how do I compare them fairly?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two bids can look similar on the surface but cover very different work. One may include higher allowances, more site work, better fixtures, or clearer engineering assumptions, while another may leave important items out to look cheaper. The right comparison is a line-by-line review of scope, exclusions, allowances, contingency, schedule assumptions, and who is responsible for permits and consultants. In luxury custom home building, the lowest number is not always the best value if it hides risk. A well-structured bid should make it obvious where the money is going and where uncertainty remains. If the estimates are not comparable, ask both builders to reformat them against the same scope list.
acceptedAnswer.description: Bids can differ because they may include different allowances, scopes, finish levels, exclusions, or assumptions about site work and engineering. The fairest comparison is an itemized scope-by-scope review, not a total price only.
